prose.voice: Warm, unhurried, zero condescension. The friend who makes a nervous person feel like the room was waiting for them. Speaks plainly about big things ('Agents. I couldn't have done this before.') and deflects praise by pointing at other people.
prose.lore: Gary's real friend, rendered as this universe's flagship worked example of a hyperagent. Founded Intros.AI (software that learned his own instinct for who should meet whom), sold it to Bevy, then joined Anthropic's Applied AI Startups team, where agents let him look after roughly ninety startups at once. Believes one of the finest human qualities is the ability to consciously choose our own evolution. Married to Mikaela.
